275034529.description:
Natural Specimen
Quartz Geode Crystal Cluster
Mineral on Green Host Rock Matrix
Approximately 3.5" x 2.5" x 2"
Unsigned
This striking natural geode specimen features a cavity of sparkling clear quartz crystals nestled within a vibrant, teal-green host rock matrix. The exterior coloration suggests the presence of copper-bearing minerals such as chrysocolla or malachite, providing a dramatic visual contrast to the prismatic crystalline interior. This piece serves as a sophisticated organic accent, showcasing the raw geological beauty and complex textures found in natural mineral formations.
Features a well-defined interior cavity lined with translucent quartz crystal clusters
Natural green and turquoise-toned host rock with earthy iron-oxide inclusions on the reverse
Unique asymmetrical form suitable for shelf, desk, or cabinet display
Condition:
Excellent natural condition. As a raw geological specimen, it retains its original jagged edges and characteristic surface variations. The crystal points appear well-preserved within the cavity, and the surrounding matrix is stable with minor natural surface wear typical of extracted mineral specimens.
